title: `EvidenceSection.jsx` "Update" workflow button shown on evidence in any status — no guard prevents reopening "Closed" evidence; backend rejects via WorkflowTransitionService but user gets opaque error
description:
Files: `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/audit-assurance-2/requirement-detail/components/EvidenceSection.jsx` lines 360–368

Root Cause: The `renderEvidenceCard()` function unconditionally renders an "Update" button for every evidence item. There is no check on `ev.status` before rendering the button. When a user clicks "Update" on evidence in "Closed" status, the `WorkflowUpdateModal` opens, they select a new status, and the backend `WorkflowTransitionService` rejects the transition with a 400 error — producing a generic error toast with no explanation.

Claude Fix Prompt:
```
Fix D-34 in EvidenceSection.jsx.

In renderEvidenceCard(), conditionally render the "Update" button:
  const isTerminal = ['Closed', 'Rejected'].includes(ev.status);
  {!isTerminal && (
    <Button ... onClick={() => openWorkflowModal(ev)}>Update</Button>
  )}
For terminal-state evidence, optionally show a read-only "View History" button instead.
This matches the backend WorkflowTransitionService which rejects transitions from terminal states.
```

title: `WorkflowStatusPanel.jsx` requirement workflow dropdown shows all statuses without indicating valid transitions from current state — backend enforces via WorkflowTransitionService but UX gives no guidance
description:
Files: `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/audit-assurance-2/requirement-detail/components/WorkflowStatusPanel.jsx` lines 83–93

Root Cause: The status `<Select>` is populated from `STATUS_OPTIONS` (all possible values) with the only validation being "not same as current". The `WorkflowTransitionService` on the backend enforces valid transitions, so invalid selections fail with a backend 400 error — the component catches and toasts the error but the user has no idea which statuses would be valid from their current state.

Claude Fix Prompt:
```
Fix D-35 in WorkflowStatusPanel.jsx.

Import the same workflow definition used by the backend (or replicate the allowed-transitions map).
Filter the status select options to only show statuses that are valid transitions from workflow.status:
  const validTransitions = WORKFLOW_TRANSITIONS[workflow?.status] || [];
  Filter STATUS_OPTIONS to only include items in validTransitions.
This eliminates the confusing backend 400 error and gives auditors clear guidance on what actions are available.
```

`CommentsSection.jsx` comment Textarea has no `maxLength` attribute — no character count displayed; users can submit arbitrarily long comments
description:
Files: `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/audit-assurance-2/requirement-detail/components/CommentsSection.jsx` lines 90–101

Root Cause: The `<Textarea>` for entering comments has no `maxLength` attribute and no character counter. Users can type and submit comments of unlimited length. The `handleAddComment()` function only validates that the comment is non-empty.

Claude Fix Prompt:
```
Fix D-38 in CommentsSection.jsx.

Add maxLength={2000} to the Textarea.
Add a character counter below:
  <Text fontSize="xs" color={mutedTextColor} textAlign="right">{commentText.length}/2000</Text>
In handleAddComment(), add a length guard:
  if (commentText.trim().length > 2000) {
    toast({ title: 'Comment too long', description: 'Maximum 2000 characters', status: 'warning' });
    return;
  }
```

title: `WorkflowStatusPanel.jsx` note minimum length check commented out — status changes submittable with a single-character note; no meaningful audit trail entry required
description:
Files: `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/audit-assurance-2/requirement-detail/components/WorkflowStatusPanel.jsx` line 92

Root Cause: The `statusUpdateSchema` Yup validation had `.min(10, 'Note must be at least 10 characters')` commented out (visible as `// .min(10, ...)`). Status changes can be submitted with a note as short as one character, providing no meaningful context in the workflow history for future reviewers.

Claude Fix Prompt:
```
Fix D-39 in WorkflowStatusPanel.jsx.

Uncomment line 92:
  note: Yup.string()
    .required('Note is required')
    .min(10, 'Note must be at least 10 characters')  // ← uncomment this
    .max(500, 'Note must not exceed 500 characters')

This ensures every status transition has a meaningful audit trail entry, meeting ISO 7.5.3 documentation requirements for controlled information changes.
```
